articles.summary: Inland American Communities (IAC), a wholly owned subsidiary of Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. (Inland American), today announced the companys acquisition of The VUE, a fully-developed student housing property located on the Texas Christian University (TCU) campus in Fort Worth, Texas. Due to its innovative design and premium amenities, the property opened in August 2012 at 100 percent occupancy. The VUE will now be rebranded as a University House community. The VUE student housing property at the Texas Christian University campus in Fort Worth, Texas (Photo: Business Wire) "The VUE is a great addition to our portfolio and meets our core investment objectives with best-in-market amenities, serves a well-known university with growing enrollment, and is in the right location," said Travis Roberts, president of Inland American Communities. articles.title: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. Purchases Student Housing Property in Fort Worth, Texas

articles.summary: Inland American Lodging Group, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc., announced today that it has acquired the six-story, 159-room Andaz San Diego, a boutique luxury hotel managed by Hyatt for a purchase price of $53 million, or approximately $333,000 per key. Andaz San Diego (Photo: Business Wire) We are very pleased to be adding this luxury asset to our portfolio, said Marcel Verbaas, president and CEO, Inland American Lodging Advisor, Inc. This purchase aligns with our objective to acquire Luxury, Upper-Upscale and urban Upscale hotels in the top 25 lodging markets. San Diego is a strategic west coast location with seven-day-a-week social and business demand generators and we are excited that we have been able to acquire one of the highest quality hotels in the downtown market at a substantial discount to development cost.
